description: One synthetic Codex transcript file: event_msg:task_started followed by its event_msg:task_complete, sharing turn_id. task_started itself produces no observation -- its whole contribution is the same-file corroboration codex_history::transform_task_complete resolves through the Keystore, exactly as a real CodexPreScan registers it (see codex_history's 'Turn duration' module doc). task_complete becomes one dev.cclog.turn.completed.v1 carrying Codex's own duration_ms and time_to_first_token_ms verbatim -- the one measurement of a turn that is not a Codex write-time, and so not recoverable any other way -- never a duration recomputed from started_at/completed_at, which are epoch seconds (not RFC 3339, not milliseconds) and appear here only to look like a real paired turn.
